steps: User presents a token intended for Service A.
Service A authenticates itself and exchanges the user assertion.
Issuer creates a scoped token intended only for Service B.
Service B validates it and authorizes the delegated user action.

lesson.scenario: A dashboard calls a reports service on behalf of a signed-in user without forwarding the upstream token to the wrong audience.

steps.title: Accept the upstream token
steps.narration: Dashboard validates iss=corporate, aud=dashboard-api, sub=E-204, azp=analytics-web, and reports.read scope.

steps.outcome: The middle tier establishes user and client context.
steps.invariant: Each hop validates its own audience, and the downstream token preserves both delegated subject and acting workload with no privilege increase.
